name: SwiftUI Pro
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and other agents that use the Agent Skills format
short: An AI skill from Paul Hudson that helps your coding agent write cleaner, modern SwiftUI and catch the mistakes LLMs usually make.
what: SwiftUI Pro is an agent skill covering navigation, layout, animation, state management, VoiceOver, performance and deprecated API. Its rules target the SwiftUI mistakes LLMs actually make, such as buttons VoiceOver can't see and deprecated calls. It's built on the author's AGENTS.md file and targets iOS 26 and Swift 6.4 or later.
who: Anyone using a coding agent to build iOS or Mac apps in SwiftUI. If you don't write SwiftUI, skip it.
needs: Node, for `npx` (the README suggests `brew install node` if it's missing)
A coding agent that loads skills

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.text: You can choose which agents get it and whether it's for one project or all of them.

steps.title: Or install it as a Claude Code plugin
Run it
steps.text: Use `/swiftui-pro` in Claude Code or `$swiftui-pro` in Codex. Add an instruction to narrow it down.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Use the SwiftUI Pro skill to look for performance problems in this project.

watch: The README notes that skills cost tokens every time they load.
